subject.title: fix(ios): shrink the chat "Jump to latest" pill to a compact icon button

question: Should the compact icon-only jump-to-latest affordance intentionally ship for both iOS and the shared macOS quick-chat surface?
rationale: The implementation uses shared `OpenClawChatUI`; the supplied rationale supports the iOS obstruction fix, but a protected maintainer review should explicitly accept the cross-platform presentation change.

options.title: Approve shared Apple presentation
options.body: Merge the focused visual refinement for both iOS and macOS quick chat while preserving the existing accessibility contract.

options.title: Scope the change to iOS
options.body: Request a platform-specific presentation if macOS should retain the labeled capsule despite sharing the underlying chat view.

recommendation.title: Approve shared Apple presentation
recommendation.body: Merge the focused visual refinement for both iOS and macOS quick chat while preserving the existing accessibility contract.
